name: away_natvent_exits_at_comfort_ceiling
description: Away mode, warm day, whole-house fan configured: nat-vent keeps free-cooling the house after the occupant leaves, until indoor reaches comfort_cool (74F); then it exits (Issue #231 away-ceiling exit in check_natural_vent_conditions()), so the empty home is not over-cooled below comfort_heat. The configured fan is the opt-in for nat-vent (Issue #1140); the no-fan pause is covered by the scenarios #1140 added.
notes: Production behavior (single-engine harness): with a whole-house fan configured, nat-vent activates while home and continues after the away transition (the away setpoint write is blocked while the fan runs, household rule 2).
While away with nat-vent active, free cooling keeps indoor below setback_cool=79F.

When indoor reaches the comfort_cool=74F ceiling, the away-ceiling-exit (Issue #231, check_natural_vent_conditions Priority-2b) exits nat-vent — further open-window cooling risks dropping below comfort_heat and accumulating violations.
The nat_vent_not_active assertion captures the Issue #231 away-ceiling-exit (live in production).

events.note: Warm-day classification (hvac_mode left to classifier.py, which derives off for a warm day)
Morning: indoor 72F within band [70F, 74F], outdoor 65F â€” nat-vent favorable
Window opens: outdoor 65F < indoor 72F, indoor > comfort_heat 70F, outdoor < threshold 77F â€” nat-vent activates
User leaves. Production: only setpoint changes to setback_cool=79F. Nat-vent continues running.

Afternoon: indoor has risen to 74F (comfort_cool ceiling). Outdoor 68F still cooler than indoor. In production (Issue #231 fix): the AWAY_CEILING exit candidate arms via decide_nat_vent_exit() but is NOT yet sustain-confirmed (Issue #821, NAT_VENT_EXIT_SUSTAIN_S=90s) — session still active this tick.

95s after the ceiling was first reached (> 90s NAT_VENT_EXIT_SUSTAIN_S) — indoor still at/above comfort_cool, outdoor still cooler than indoor. AWAY_CEILING exit sustain-confirms and commits: nat-vent exits at comfort_cool ceiling to prevent further warming risk.

assertions.reason: Window opens with outdoor 65F < indoor 72F, indoor > comfort_heat 70F, outdoor under the 77F threshold and a whole-house fan configured (the opt-in for nat-vent, Issue #1140): nat-vent activates while occupancy is home.

Away transition at 10:00 while the whole-house fan is running nat-vent: the setback_cool=79F write to the thermostat is blocked because the whole-house fan and HVAC never run together (household rule 2). handle_occupancy_away() does not exit nat-vent; only the setpoint write is held off.

Issue #231 fix is live in production: when indoor reaches comfort_cool=74F ceiling while away and nat-vent is active, check_natural_vent_conditions() Priority-2b path exits nat-vent. Free cooling has done its job; further outdoor air risks over-cooling below the comfort band. Issue #821 retiming: the exit is sustain-confirmed (NAT_VENT_EXIT_SUSTAIN_S=90s) rather than committing on the instantaneous tick the ceiling was first reached — this assertion now sits 95s after that tick, on the follow-up temp_update that confirms indoor genuinely held at/above the ceiling. The nat_vent_still_active assertion at 10:00 was removed — it used the final engine snapshot (which captures the 14:01:35 exit), making it impossible to assert mid-run state. The continue-through-away behavior is covered by away_with_active_natvent_transition.

verdict.summary: Nat-vent uses free cooling while away, exits at comfort_cool ceiling (74F) via Issue #231 away-ceiling-exit path
verdict.observed_behavior: nat-vent activates while home, persists through away transition (setback applied), exits when indoor reaches comfort_cool=74F
verdict.expected_behavior: Free cooling opportunity exploited while away; ceiling exit at comfort_cool prevents over-cooling and accumulating comfort violations in the band
